existingFixParts.note: PRIMARY fix per resolution. Do NOT use ATF+4 - the ZF 8HP needs 8&9-Speed ATF. Sold per quart; a drain-and-fill takes ~7-9 qt. Pair with TCM software reflash (dealer/wiTECH, not a buyable part) + adaptive relearn first - that resolves most shift complaints with no hardware.
existingFixParts.component: ZF-approved 8-speed ATF (ZF Lifeguard 8 / Mopar 8 & 9 Speed ATF) - fluid for the spec'd fluid change

existingFixParts.note: Needed alongside the fluid for a proper service. Applies to 845RE (3.6L V6 / 5.7L V8 gas). For the 3.0L EcoDiesel (ZF 8HP70) use Mopar 68225344AA / ZF 1087.298.361 instead. Filter is bonded into the plastic pan - replace the whole pan.
existingFixParts.component: Transmission oil pan with integrated filter (filter is part of the pan on the ZF 8HP/845RE)

existingFixParts.component: Transmission oil pan gasket (if using a metal reusable pan / filter-only kit)

existingFixParts.note: Needed alongside the fluid for a proper service. Applies to 845RE (3.6L V6 / 5.7L V8 gas). For the 3.0L EcoDiesel (ZF 8HP70) use Mopar 68225344AA / ZF 1087.298.361 instead. Filter is bonded into the plastic pan - replace the whole pan.
existingFixParts.component: Transmission oil pan with integrated filter (filter is part of the pan on the ZF 8HP/845RE)

existingFixParts.note: Most OEM plastic pan-and-filter assemblies ship with the gasket; only order separately for a reusable-pan/filter-only service. Also budget the Torx pan bolts (Mopar 6510066AA x5, 6510065AA x15) if reusing isn't possible.
existingFixParts.component: Transmission oil pan gasket (if using a metal reusable pan / filter-only kit)

existingFixParts.note: Last-resort per resolution ('valve body inspection or replacement may be needed'). results.component: Front Brake Rotor (WK, 2005-2010) — pair
results.repairRoleEvidence: Existing fixParts:0 must be reverified and keyed-merged.

existingFixParts.note: Per-rotor price; buy in pairs. 2005-2010 WK & 06-10 Commander XK. Coated (FZN) resists the corrosion that drives runout/warping. Replace both fronts together, do NOT just machine thin rotors.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Rotor (WK, 2005-2010) — pair

existingFixParts.note: Fits 05-10 Grand Cherokee WK & 06-10 Commander XK. Akebono ceramic (ACT1057) matches OE feel and reduces dust/pulsation recurrence. Pair with new rotors + clean hub face.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Pad Set (WK, 2005-2010)

existingFixParts.note: Sticking/seized slide pins are the root cause of uneven pad wear + heat-induced rotor pulsation. Replace bushings/boots and re-lube with high-temp silicone grease, or warping returns.
existingFixParts.component: Front Caliper Guide Pin / Bushing Kit (WK, 2005-2010)

existingFixParts.note: Per-rotor; same rotor for both Akebono and Teves WJ systems. OE 52098672 (a.k.a. 5018672) superseded by 1BP00064AA. Coated rotor (76793FZN) best fights the rust-runout warping cycle.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Rotor (WJ, 1999-2004) — pair

existingFixParts.note: WJ has TWO caliper systems — you MUST physically check the caliper (VIN won't tell you). Akebono = silver caliper, solid bracket. ACT748 is the OE-match ceramic.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Pad Set (WJ, Akebono caliper, built 5/11/2002 to end of WJ — silver caliper, solid bracket)

existingFixParts.note: Teves = black caliper, open-sided bracket, spring clip on outer pad. Wrong-system pads will not seat and will cause pulsation. Confirm caliper visually before ordering.
existingFixParts.component: Front Brake Pad Set (WJ, Continental Teves/TRW caliper, 1999 to 5/10/2002 — black caliper, open-sided bracket + spring c

existingFixParts.note: If a WJ caliper sticks, pads/rotor warp again fast. Service the pins/bushings or rebuild/replace the caliper. Akebono pin kit 5093184AA; if upgrading Teves-to-Akebono, caliper kit is 5093174AA.
existingFixParts.component: Front Caliper Slide/Pin Kit (WJ, Akebono) — sticking-caliper fix

existingFixParts.note: THE fix for the early-build left-head failure (cyl 2/4/6 burnt exhaust valves, P0300/P0302-04-06). 68141353AC supersedes RL141353AA/AB, 68141353AA/AB, 68196637AA — buy the latest -AC revision (redesigned cooling/valve seats), not an early casting. Reman ~$775; new Mopar MSRP $1,190, street ~$960-1,0
existingFixParts.component: Left (driver-side) cylinder head assembly — with valves, redesigned/hardened seats (3.6L Pentastar)
aftermarketXref: Heavy Duty Parts Co reman left

existingFixParts.note: Optional/secondary — the documented early failure is the LEFT head. Only replace the right head if compression/scope confirms right-bank damage. Different PN than left; do not mix them up.
existingFixParts.component: Right (passenger-side) cylinder head assembly — with valves (only if right bank also affected)

existingFixParts.note: Fix for tick caused by collapsed/worn rocker (cam lobe slapping a seized roller). Use the latest -AH revision (full-floating center pin) — it cured the tick. Sold per arm; a head has 12 (intake+exhaust). Replace lifters at the same time. Each unit cheap, but kit of 24 rockers + 24 lifters runs ~$150
existingFixParts.component: Rocker arm (roller finger follower) — revised anti-tick design
aftermarketXref: Melling (full-floating-pin rocker, sold as kit with lifters)

existingFixParts.note: Replace with the rocker arms — a collapsed lifter is the other common tick source. 12 per head / 24 per engine. Melling JB7525 is the proven cross-ref. Sold individually or in 24-pc rocker+lifter kits (~$150-300).
existingFixParts.component: Hydraulic lifter / lash adjuster (valve lifter)

existingFixParts.note: Head bolts are torque-to-yield (torque-plus-angle) and MUST be replaced when a head comes off — do not reuse. Sold per bolt; need the full set for the bank. Order with the head gasket set.

existingFixParts.component: PCV valve (3.8L V6 / EGH)

existingFixParts.note: Replace alongside the PCV valve. The PCV tube/hose on the 3.8L gets oil-soaked and cracks/clogs, defeating crankcase ventilation and worsening oil pull-through. existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part for early TJ (2000-2001, same 4-terminal resistor as 1997-2001 Cherokee XJ). This card-type resistor is the exact part that loses low/medium fan speeds when its coils burn open; high still works because it bypasses the resistor. Mounts on the HVAC housing under the passenger side
existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor (2000-2001 TJ, pre-2002 HVAC)

existingFixParts.note: Primary repair part for the 2002-2006 TJ after the HVAC redesign (shared with 2002-2007 Liberty KJ). Different resistor than the 2000-2001 part. Same failure mode: fan drops lower speeds first, then works only on high. Verify model year before ordering since 2002 is the split point.
existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor (2002-2006 TJ, redesigned HVAC)

existingFixParts.note: TSB/repair-kit companion part. 1999-2001 TJs are notorious for the resistor connector overheating and melting, so the documented fix commonly replaces the pigtail alongside the resistor. Crown 5019941AA fits 97-06 TJ (and XJ) as an OEM-spec discontinued-harness replacement; Dorman 973-305 is the con
existingFixParts.component: Blower Motor Resistor Pigtail / Connector Repair Harness (2000-2006 TJ)

existingFixParts.note: Secondary part: the documented fix notes a dragging blower motor draws excess current and re-cooks a new resistor, so many repairs replace both. This is the 2002-2006 twist-lock motor (shared with Liberty KJ). Only needed if measured current draw is high; otherwise resistor + pigtail alone.
existingFixParts.component: Heater/A-C Blower Motor with Wheel (2002-2006 TJ, only if motor is dragging/high current)

existingFixParts.note: Secondary part for the pre-2002 TJ, matching the 2000-2001 resistor (4864957) era. Replace only if current-draw test shows the motor is dragging. results.component: rear output shaft seal
results.repairRoleEvidence: Replace the rear output shaft seal (National/SKF 18662 or equivalent) after cleaning/inspecting the yoke and tail bushing

existingFixParts.note: THE primary basic-fix part for 97-06 TJ. Mopar/Crown OE 4798117 (~2.76" OD x 1.83" ID) fits NP231 and NP242 rear output slip-yoke. NOTE: the issue text lists 'National/SKF 18662' for the basic fix — that is WRONG; 18662 is the SYE fixed-yoke seal (see separate line). Tape over the retainer-clip groo
existingFixParts.component: Rear output shaft seal — TJ (1997-2006), NP231/NP242

existingFixParts.note: Era-correct basic-fix seal for the 1994-95 YJ (and 87-95 YJ / 87-95 XJ). Different part from the TJ seal — the 4798117 supersedes for 96+ vehicles. Use this one for the pre-TJ years in the 1994-2006 span.
existingFixParts.component: Rear output shaft seal — YJ (1994-1995), NP231

existingFixParts.note: This is the seal the issue text mis-labeled as the 'basic' seal. It fits the SMALLER fixed yoke of an SYE conversion (~1.937" ID x 2.750" OD) — only used if you install an SYE kit, NOT for a stock slip-yoke reseal. Fits TeraFlex / Advance Adapters / JB Conversions / Rugged Ridge SYE yokes on NP231/2
existingFixParts.component: SYE fixed-yoke output seal (Slip-Yoke Eliminator path)

existingFixParts.note: Housing-side oil seal for the Rugged Ridge/Omix NP231 SYE housing (18676.60). Era-correct for 87-06 YJ/TJ NP231 SYE conversions. Only relevant on the SYE-upgrade path, paired with the 18662 yoke seal.
existingFixParts.component: SYE tail-housing oil seal (Rugged Ridge/Omix)

existingFixParts.note: Full fixed-yoke conversion for NP231 in YJ/TJ. Chosen when the tail bushing is worn or a lift causes driveline vibration. Crown RT24005 verified as an NP231 SYE kit. REQUIRES a matching CV rear driveshaft (below).
existingFixParts.component: Slip-Yoke Eliminator (SYE) kit (optional upgrade for worn tail bushing / lift vibration)

notes: No reviewed component-to-catalog mapping; no catalog request was made.

existingFixParts.note: The actual fix part for 1st-gear pop-out: worn 1st/2nd synchro + speed-gear back taper is the documented NSG370 root cause. Requires gearbox teardown. OEM Mopar ~$700-1085; USA Standard aftermarket assembly is the budget cross-ref. Inspect 1st speed gear back taper while in there.
existingFixParts.component: NSG370 1st & 2nd Gear Synchronizer Assembly

existingFixParts.note: Cheap first step per the resolution text - this trans REQUIRES the special MS-9224 synthetic, NOT gear oil; wrong/old fluid worsens notchy shifts and hop-out. ~2 qts per fill. Do this before opening the case; if pop-out persists it is mechanical (synchro).
existingFixParts.component: NSG370 / NV3500 Manual Transmission Fluid (MS-9224)
aftermarketXref: Spec: Chrysler MS-9224 synthetic manual trans fluid

existingFixParts.note: Add only if reverse also pops out (very common alongside the 1st-gear issue on 05-06 TJ). Mopar service kit: internal shift sub-assy, reverse gear, reverse synchro sleeve, blocker ring, snap rings, seals. Not needed if reverse is fine.
existingFixParts.component: NSG370 Reverse Gear Update Kit (companion pop-out TSB)

existingFixParts.note: Buy with the synchro job - once the case is open, replace bearings/seals too. BK478 (~$300) = bearings/seals only; BK478AWS/WS (~$700-900) bundle all synchro rings for a complete rebuild. No single OEM Mopar PN (kit is aftermarket-assembled).

results.component: opda
results.repairRoleEvidence: replacing the OPDA with an updated unit and inspecting the cam gear for abnormal wear before reinstalling

existingFixParts.note: Primary fix. Factory unit starves the upper bronze bushing (seal cuts off oil) causing squeal + cam gear wear. Crown's 53010624AC fixes the lube path - prefer it over a plain reman. Verify cam gear wear before reinstall; 2005-2006 requires a cam/crank relearn after install.
existingFixParts.component: OPDA (Oil Pump Drive Assembly / camshaft synchronizer) for 4.0L I6

existingFixParts.note: Secondary. The Crown OPDA usually ships with a sensor - use the sensor matched to the OPDA brand for reliable sync (mixing brands causes no-start/sync faults). OEM 5149034AA is largely discontinued; perform cam/crank relearn after any sensor swap.
existingFixParts.component: Camshaft Position Sensor (cam sync sensor, mounts in the OPDA)

existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2007-2010 JK, 4-door/2-door dash-mounted)

existingFixParts.note: Correct master switch for the LATER 4-door JK (2011-2018). Supersession 68057595AC -> 68156217AA -> AB -> AC. This is the era-correct replacement for the (incorrectly cited) 68290764AE. Replace if all windows quit / wrong-window operation / water intrusion at contacts.
existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2011-2018 JK Unlimited 4-door)

existingFixParts.note: Separate 2-door JK (2011-2018) master switch — distinct PN from the 4-door 68156217AC. Confirmed on Mopar eStore as 2011-2018 fitment. Use this for 2-door JKs; the 4-door PN will not match the button layout.
existingFixParts.component: Driver's master power window switch (2011-2018 JK 2-door)

existingFixParts.note: Front LEFT (driver) window regulator w/ 2-pin motor, fits 07-18 JK with power windows. Replace when the motor whirs/grinds but glass won't move (broken plastic guides/clips). existingFixParts.component: Front passenger-side power window regulator with motor (front right) — if the right window is the failed one

existingFixParts.component: Soft top zipper cleaner & lubricant (proper non-WD-40 zipper care)

Companion soft-top foam tape

results.component: Front Steering Stabilizer / Damper
results.repairRoleEvidence: Existing fixParts:0 must be reverified and keyed-merged.

existingFixParts.note: Primary buyable part named in the fix. OEM 52060058AF is the well-corroborated JK service damper (RockAuto/Quadratec/Mopar). A new/HD damper only masks death wobble — diagnose the track bar + joints FIRST, then replace the damper. Bilstein 24-158428 is the most-recommended budget HD upgrade.

Mopar OEM ran through revisions 5012952AA/AB/AC/AD (AD is the latest supersession). This is the whole-module fix the issue calls for — do n
existingFixParts.component: Fuel pump module assembly — 1997-2002 TJ, 19-gallon tank (2.5L / 4.0L)

existingFixParts.note: Alternate module for the early TJs (1997-1999 only) fitted with the smaller 15-gallon tank. Note the one-digit OEM difference from the 19-gal unit: 5012951 (15-gal) vs 5012952 (19-gal). The issue explicitly warns to confirm 15- vs 19-gallon tank before ordering — this covers the 15-gal case. Include
existingFixParts.component: Fuel pump module assembly — 1997-1999 TJ, 15-gallon tank (2.5L / 4.0L)

existingFixParts.note: Later-generation module for the revised 2003-2004 tank/pump design (Mopar latest rev 5093788AB; Crown reproduces it as 5093788AA). existingFixParts.component: Fuel pump module assembly — 2003-2004 TJ (2.4L 4-cyl / 4.0L 6-cyl)

existingFixParts.note: Required consumable — the rubber seal/gasket between the module flange and the fuel tank. Mopar 52018808 covers 1997-2004 TJ (and Unlimited). Always replace when dropping the module; the issue's fix specifically calls for renewing the pump-to-tank seal. (Note: 55366298AA/4721916AA lock-ring & seal a

existingFixParts.note: CRITICAL for 3.6L Pentastar (JK 2012-2018, JL early).
